document.cue: Describe a healthy habit you have.

text: One healthy habit I've managed to keep is swimming. I go to the pool at a sports centre near my university twice a week, usually on Tuesday and Friday mornings before classes.

I started about two years ago, when I noticed that sitting at a desk all day was giving me backache. At first I could barely manage four lengths without stopping, and I felt quite embarrassed next to the regulars, who seemed to glide through the water effortlessly.

These days I swim for about forty minutes each time, which works out at roughly a kilometre and a half. I try not to skip sessions, even in winter, when getting out of a warm bed at six thirty in the morning takes real willpower.

The reason I think it's so good for me is that it works on the whole body without putting pressure on the joints. My backache has almost disappeared, and I sleep much better on swimming days. It's also surprisingly good for my mind, because in the water there's no phone and no notifications — just the sound of my own breathing.
So what started as a way to fix my back has turned into something I genuinely look forward to, and I can't imagine giving it up now.
